scripts.build:vercel: case "$VERCEL_ENV" in production) npx convex deploy --cmd 'npm run build' ;; preview) if [ -n "$CONVEX_DEPLOY_KEY" ] && expr "$CONVEX_DEPLOY_KEY" : 'preview:' >/dev/null 2>&1; then npx convex deploy --cmd 'npm run build'; else echo '[build] No preview-scoped CONVEX_DEPLOY_KEY (one starting preview:) in this Vercel environment, so convex deploy is skipped and Next.js builds against the statically set NEXT_PUBLIC_CONVEX_URL (none is set for Preview on this project yet, so add one or the app has no Convex backend). For isolated previews, generate a preview deploy key in the Convex dashboard and set it as CONVEX_DEPLOY_KEY for the Vercel Preview environment only.' && npm run build; fi ;; *) npm run build ;; esac
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
